title: HQ plays the alert sound even when alerts are off
what: When something new arrives, HQ plays its short sound before it checks whether alerts were turned on. So after the owner taps Block, or never taps Turn on alerts, HQ still beeps whenever the browser lets it, while the page says alerts stay off.
expected: No sound unless alerts were turned on with the button, as the page and the code comment say.
how_often: every new item while HQ is open with alerts off
fix_line: Play the sound only when alerts are on
